Name: Robotic Arms & Manipulators
Short Description: Design, integration, and programming of robotic arms for precision automation tasks.
Detail (expanded): We integrate ABB, FANUC, UR, and custom robotic arms with PLCs and machine vision systems, tailored for packaging, welding, inspection, and more.

Name: Custom Machinery
Short Description: Machines designed and built to your exact operational and space requirements.
Detail (expanded): From concept to commissioning, we create CNC-based jigs, pick-and-place systems, assembly lines, and mobile robotic platforms customized to your specs.

Name: Systems Integration
Short Description: Bridging hardware and software — PLC, SCADA, HMIs, sensors, drives, and cloud platforms.
Detail (expanded): We synchronize machines, databases, ERP/SCADA, and secure IIoT platforms to deliver full process visibility and efficiency.

Name: Conveyor Belt Systems
Short Description: Material handling systems for packaging, sorting, and logistics optimization.
Detail (expanded): From powered rollers to modular belts and servo-tracked smart conveyors, we build scalable and safe solutions for manufacturing and warehousing.

Name: Robotic Training
Short Description: On-site or virtual hands-on training for robotics operation, maintenance, and programming.
Detail (expanded): Our training covers safety standards, PLC ladder logic, arm kinematics, ROS basics, and HMI interaction — tailored to your team's experience.

Name: Control Systems Engineering
Short Description: PLC, VFD, and HMI control systems designed, programmed, and commissioned for reliable operation in the field.
Detail (expanded): We engineer control systems and instrumentation — PLC/VFD/HMI programming, I/O design, drawings, and functional testing — and coordinate panel fabrication with certified panel shops where a listed build is required. Complete documentation delivered at handover.
